rv.q: For all its dreamlike fluidity, however, her monologue is more poetic than dramatic.

Norah’s taped account follows no structure. It jumps messily from a description of a “beautiful man” (Tyler Cameron), who appears outside holding an axe, to feelings of disgust and fear. The set, designed by Lizzie Clachan, is an impressive, intrusive construction: Norah is trapped here, away from the city existence she once knew.
